origin: decision D31, second correction round (noted by the corrector, outside its findings)
problem: `vsdd env start` turns every live temporary flag on for the wave and release evaluations. That includes a flag whose feature is unfinished, so hidden scenarios of behaviour that exists today could fail there for a reason that is not a defect.
proposed_resolution: Decide which flags an evaluation turns on: only flags that have no pending test and whose stories in the wave are all delivered, with the others left at their default; say so where the override is defined and test it with a wave that holds one finished and one unfinished flag.

origin: decision D31, second correction round (noted by the corrector, outside its findings)
problem: The pull request's Rollback and Feature flags sections are written for any story that names a flag. That includes a story that removes a flag, where turning the flag off is not a way back.
proposed_resolution: For a removal or withdrawal story, have the Rollback section say that the way back is to revert the merge, and leave out the line about turning the flag off.

origin: decision D31, second correction round (noted by the corrector, outside its findings)
problem: A test can still be moved as `pending` after its flag has been turned on in the repository's definitions; nothing refuses it until a later removal story names it.
proposed_resolution: Have F-STATES refuse a new `pending` move for a flag whose definition already serves the on value, or have the turn-on check run again when such a move is made.
